description: Build the steps that open a leveraged position. Returns UNSIGNED transaction steps for the owner to sign in order; this server never holds keys or sends transactions. The build expires after 180 seconds (`expiresAt`, unix ms): build immediately before signing, not as a plan for later. Builds are single-use: rebuilding an open predicts a different position address, so never replay one. A successful build does not guarantee a successful transaction: pass `steps` to `simulate` and check `ok` before asking anyone to sign. `tokenIn` (zap-in) is build-only: quote in the collateral token, then set `tokenIn` here to add the swap. With `tokenIn` set, `amount` is in `tokenIn` decimals. A zap-in is simulated by the build itself, and a failure gets 422 `simulation_reverted`. Any build the owner funds (open, adjust push, manual repay), zap-in or not, gets 422 `insufficient_balance` (`token`, `required`, `available`) when the owner holds less than it pulls.

amount.description: Collateral (or tokenIn) amount in base units

approvalMode.description: ERC-20 approval size. 'exact' (default) approves only this amount

forceSwapper.description: Retry only: route the swap through the swapper instead of the routing engine. Set it when simulate reports a build as failing, then rebuild.

leverage.description: Target leverage as a plain number between 1.01 and 100: 3 means 3x (not 1e18 fixed-point). An open must borrow, so 1 is not accepted; to add collateral without borrowing, adjust an existing position

owner.description: EOA that owns the position and signs the steps. The smart account is derived from it server-side.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal: 0.005 means 0.5% (not 1e18 fixed-point)

name: build_open
title: Build open
